originalTitle: Pakistan ex-PM Imran Khan back in jail after hospital examination
summary: It comes as the court had earlier this week ordered that he had to be taken for a hospital examination.
content:
Imran Khan has been in prison since 2023

Pakistan's former Prime Minister Imran Khan was moved back to prison early on Friday after being examined by doctors at a hospital in Islamabad, who deemed him "medically fit".

Khan was seen by "a team of qualified doctors" including an ophthalmologist, a cardiologist and a physician, Pakistan's Information Minister Attaullah Tarar said.

The Supreme Court had on Tuesday ordered the cricketer-turned-politician be taken to a specific private hospital within 48 hours to be examined by physicians, following complaints about his health.

He was ultimately taken to a different government-run hospital.

The intervention was the most significant relief Khan has received from the courts since he was imprisoned in 2023 on corruption charges, which he says were politically motivated.

As well as being transferred to hospital, the court order also specified Khan should be allowed to see his family, which he has not been able to do in months. On Tuesday night, his sister Noreen Khan visited him in prison.

His other sister Dr. Uzma Khan accompanied him during the hospital visit last night. She was present throughout all stages of the medical examination overnight on Thursday, Tarar said.

Khan was meant to be sent to the private Shifa Interational Hospital in Islamabad, according to the Supreme Court order.

The area around it was sealed off with barriers, with officers and police vans in place. Outside, the BBC saw cars being moved with a truck to clear the street while police cars and armoured vehicles patrolled.

Some PTI activists had gathered along the route and near the hospital, despite warnings from the court and party leaders not to.

But Tarar later confirmed Khan had not been taken there and was instead driven to the government-run Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences (PIMS) hospital. A senior police official told the BBC the security presence outside Shifa was a decoy.

Tarar said the change had been made due to the "security situation created by PTI workers".

The PTI's Information Secretary Sheikh Waqas Akram asked: "Was the court order implemented in its true spirit, or was it merely a superficial exercise for propaganda?"

Watch: BBC outside hospital where Imran Khan has been taken for treatment

Khan's lawyers have said he is suffering from various health conditions, including poor eyesight, and has been unable to access specialist medical care.

In February, the 73-year-old's lawyer said his client had 15% vision left in his right eye after prison authorities failed to take action - an allegation the government disputed.

In Tuesday's court order, the panel wrote: "We are mindful of the constitutional and legal obligation... to safeguard the life, health, dignity and security of the prisoner."

Judges said an eye specialist would be involved in Khan's hospital treatment.

Khan, who previously captained the Pakistan national cricket team, served as the country's prime minister from 2018 to 2022.

He was imprisoned in August 2023 and has faced charges in more than 100 cases, ranging from leaking state secrets to selling state gifts - all of which he decried as politically motivated.

Khan and his wife Bushra Bibi were both sentenced to 17 years late last year .

His jailing triggered large-scale protests by supporters, which were met with a crackdown by authorities.

Despite his jailing, Khan remains a significant presence in Pakistani politics with a large number of supporters.

chineseTitle: 巴基斯坦前总理伊姆兰·汗在医院检查后重返监狱
chineseSummary: 本周早些时候，法院下令必须将他送往医院检查。
chineseContent:
伊姆兰·汗 (Imran Khan) 自 2023 年起一直入狱

巴基斯坦前总理伊姆兰·汗在伊斯兰堡一家医院接受医生检查后，于周五早些时候被送回监狱，医生认为他“身体状况良好”。

巴基斯坦信息部长阿塔拉·塔拉尔表示，汗接受了“一组合格的医生”的诊治，其中包括一名眼科医生、一名心脏病专家和一名内科医生。

在接到有关这位板球运动员出身的政治家的健康投诉后，最高法院周二下令在 48 小时内将这位板球运动员送往一家特定的私立医院接受医生检查。

他最终被送往另一家政府运营的医院。

此次干预是汗自 2023 年因腐败指控入狱以来从法院获得的最重大救济，他表示腐败指控是出于政治动机。

除了被转移到医院外，法院命令还规定汗应该被允许见他的家人，但他已经几个月无法见到家人了。周二晚上，他的妹妹诺琳·汗 (Noreen Khan) 去监狱探望了他。

他的另一个妹妹乌兹玛·汗医生昨晚陪同他去医院探望。塔拉尔说，周四晚上，她参加了体检的所有阶段。

根据最高法院的命令，汗本应被送往伊斯兰堡的私立希法国际医院。

周围地区已被路障封锁，并有警察和警车就位。在外面，英国广播公司看到一辆卡车正在移动汽车以清理街道，而警车和装甲车则在巡逻。

尽管法院和政党领导人警告不要这样做，但一些 PTI 活动人士还是沿着路线和医院附近聚集。

但塔拉尔后来证实汗没有被带到那里，而是被送往政府运营的巴基斯坦医学科学研究所（PIMS）医院。一名高级警官告诉英国广播公司，希法外的安全人员是一个诱饵。

塔拉尔表示，做出这一改变是由于“PTI 工作人员造成的安全局势”。

PTI 信息秘书谢赫·瓦卡斯·阿克拉姆 (Sheikh Waqas Akram) 问道：“法院命令是按照其真实精神执行的，还是只是表面上的宣传活动？”

观看：BBC 在伊姆兰·汗被送往医院接受治疗的医院外

汗的律师表示，他患有多种健康问题，包括视力不佳，并且无法获得专业医疗护理。

今年 2 月，这位 73 岁老人的律师表示，由于监狱当局未能采取行动，他的当事人的右眼视力只剩下 15%，但政府对这一指控提出了异议。

在周二的法院命令中，专家组写道：“我们铭记宪法和法律义务……保护囚犯的生命、健康、尊严和安全。”

法官表示，一名眼科专家将参与汗的医院治疗。

汗曾担任巴基斯坦国家板球队队长，并于 2018 年至 2022 年担任该国总理。

他于 2023 年 8 月入狱，面临 100 多起案件的指控，从泄露国家机密到出售国家礼品，他谴责所有这些都是出于政治动机。

Khan 和他的妻子 Bushra Bibi 去年年底均被判处 17 年徒刑。

他的入狱引发了支持者的大规模抗议，但遭到当局镇压。

尽管被监禁，汗仍然在巴基斯坦政坛发挥着重要作用，拥有大量支持者。

乌斯曼·扎希德的补充报道

布什拉·比比（Bushra Bibi）领导了一场释放伊姆兰·汗（Imran Khan）的抗议活动——接下来发生的事情是个谜

伊姆兰·汗并不是唯一一个因巴基斯坦军方镇压异议而被压制的人
